description: This file contains the implementation of the nusoap_base class, which provides core functionalities for the NuSOAP toolkit, including serialization, namespace management, and debugging. It serves as a foundational component for building, parsing, and handling SOAP messages within the project.

classes.name: nusoap_base
classes.description: Provides core SOAP serialization and namespace management functions, debugging, and error handling for the NuSOAP toolkit.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the nusoap_base object, setting the default debug level.

methods.name: getGlobalDebugLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the global debug level applicable to all instances.

methods.name: setGlobalDebugLevel
methods.description: Sets the global debug level for all instances.

methods.name: getDebugLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the debug level for this specific instance.

methods.name: setDebugLevel
methods.description: Sets the debug level for this specific instance.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Appends debug information with timestamp and class context.

methods.name: appendDebug
methods.description: Appends debug string without additional formatting.

methods.name: clearDebug
methods.description: Clears the current debug data from the instance.

methods.name: getDebug
methods.description: Returns the debug data collected so far.

methods.name: getDebugAsXMLComment
methods.description: Returns the debug data wrapped as an XML comment.

methods.name: expandEntities
methods.description: Expands special characters into their corresponding XML entities if character encoding is enabled.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the current error string, if any.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets an error message for the object.

methods.name: isArraySimpleOrStruct
methods.description: Determines whether an array is a simple array or an associative array (struct).

methods.name: serialize_val
methods.description: Serializes PHP values into XML according to SOAP and schema specifications, supporting complex types, arrays, nulls, and primitive types.

methods.name: serializeEnvelope
methods.description: Constructs a complete SOAP envelope message with optional headers, styles, and encoding styles.

methods.name: formatDump
methods.description: Formats a string for HTML display, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: contractQname
methods.description: Converts a qualified name to a namespace-prefixed name.

methods.name: expandQname
methods.description: Expands a namespace prefix in a QName to its full namespace URI.

methods.name: getLocalPart
methods.description: Extracts the local part from a prefixed QName.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Extracts the prefix from a prefixed QName.

methods.name: getNamespaceFromPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves the namespace URI associated with a given prefix.

methods.name: getPrefixFromNamespace
methods.description: Finds a prefix associated with a namespace URI.

methods.name: getmicrotime
methods.description: Returns the current time with microsecond resolution in a string format.

methods.name: varDump
methods.description: Returns the output of var_dump() as a string for debugging.
